name: Slugma (CobbleEffort form)
look: a slug of oily sludge rising from a lime puddle to a wavy drippy cap, its edges burning with a glowing oil-slick rainbow
entry: It oozes up out of tar pits, a slug of burning oil. The rainbow sheen on its skin is a film of fuel; it flares up whenever the Pokémon gets angry, and the smell lingers for days.
how: Wild: rare in tar pits and tar lakes (with CobbleEffort: Kanto), rarely near lava in badlands, and in the Nether's basalt deltas.
Evolves into Petroil when you use a Garbage Bag on it (a rare drop from Garbodor).
